beats.text: This lake holds up to forty percent salt, making its water extremely buoyant.
It is Lake Retba, the pink lake north-east of Dakar, Senegal.
Dry season water reaches three hundred fifty grams salt per litre.
Its density lets visitors float effortlessly without swimming.
Thirty eight thousand tonnes of salt are harvested each year.
UNESCO has considered it for Heritage since October two thousand five.
In twenty twenty five the lake regained some pink colour after the flood.
